description: Palette of the design guide (docs/design-guide.md, section 4): the only colours allowed in the textures of the mod. Single source, read by design/tools/wwb_design.py and by BlockResourcesTest. Each role has a base tone and may have a highlight (hi) and a shadow (sh) tone.

cords.description: Colours of the cords, a family of their own (design guide, section 4): cable, boot of the plugs and the cord item. Not allowed in the textures of the devices. Chosen by Max on 2026-11-20; blue, the colour of every cord today (CableRenderer), is the default.

exceptions.textures/item/ethernet_cable.png: Cords are a colour family of their own (design guide, section 4); the icon is reworked in lot F.
exceptions.textures/block/rj45_plug.png: Temporary: the boots of the plug use the cord colours; replaced by the rule of the cord colours for the plug and the cord icon only (issue 1d/07).
